steps.title: Pick your experience
steps.text: Choose a park, boat trip, site or event and tell us the date.

steps.title: We reserve for you
steps.text: We book your slot, pay fees locally and confirm within hours.

steps.title: Show your e-ticket
steps.text: Your QR ticket arrives on your phone. Just scan at the entrance.

benefits: Free date change up to 48 h before
Local guide or driver arranged on request

faqs.a: Most can be moved to another date for free up to 48 hours before. Refund terms are shown in your quote before you pay.

faqs.q: Do I need to print my ticket?
faqs.a: No. You receive an e-ticket with a QR code. Keep it on your phone and show it at the entrance.

faqs.q: Can you book for a group?
faqs.a: Yes. For groups of 8 or more we can arrange a private time slot and a guide for the whole group.

faqs.q: What if my chosen date is sold out?
faqs.a: We suggest the closest available dates or a similar experience nearby, and hold it for you while you decide.

faqs.q: Are park fees and guides included?
faqs.a: Each ticket tells you exactly what is included. Park fees and mandatory local guides are included wherever they apply.

faqs.q: Can you book events far in advance?
faqs.a: Yes, as soon as organizers open ticket sales. Tell us the dates you travel and we watch for you.
